name: Curse Of The Succubus
source:
Abandoned by his own father, sent to the middle of nowhere, and to top it all he ends up at an all-girls high school. Life may be a little hard to our hero, but hey … not much else that could possible go wrong at this stage, right?
Wrong.
From one day to the next he has to deal with a love-struck demoness who wants to be with him, his own strange family and the worst thing that can happen to a young man: horny classmates.
But all of this is just the beginning of a far greater adventure, the outcome of which will determine not only his own future, but the survival of all mankind.

[From [url=https://allardgames.itch.io/curse-of-the-succubus]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
親爹把他丟下，他被送到一個前不著村後不著店的地方，末了還進了一所女子高中。我們這位主角的日子也許是有點難過，不過，都已經這樣了，總不會再出什麼岔子了吧？

錯了。

一夜之間，他得應付一個一心想和他在一起的痴情女惡魔、自己那一家子怪人，還有一個小夥子能碰上的最糟糕的事——一群慾火正旺的同班同學。

而這一切只是一場更大冒險的開端。它的結局將決定他的未來，乃至全人類的生死存亡。

[摘自[url=https://allardgames.itch.io/curse-of-the-succubus]itch.io[/url]]
